text:
This is a leftover tray, so I estimated only what remains on it. I did not estimate the original meal.

Items and rough estimates:
- Brownie or cake slice: about 60 g, 250 kcal per 100 g, so about 150 kcal.
- Chicken drumstick, mostly bone with some meat and skin: about 50 g, about 100 kcal.
- Gravy and sauce: about 30 g, about 30 kcal.
- Cookie or cracker with cream: about 30 g, about 120 kcal.
- Leftover noodles: about 30 g, about 45 kcal.
- Orange juice, roughly 150 g, about 65 kcal. I counted this as a drink.
- Chocolate or coffee milk, roughly 100 g left in the bottle, about 70 kcal. I also counted this as a drink.
- Water: 0 kcal.
- Pink sauce in the bowl: about 20 g, about 10 kcal.

The solid food comes to about 455 kcal and about 220 g. Adding the juice and milk gives about 590 kcal and about 470 g.

I'm reporting the figure that includes the drinks.

{"kcal": 590, "mass_g": 470}
